Method of Attack: Unpublish (yank) certain Ruby packages and republish tainted or malicious versions with the same file names and version numbers
Hijacking by exploiting authorization bypass in yank action
Impacted Systems: Software supply chain using Ruby gems
Attack Vector: Exploiting vulnerability in RubyGems.org yank action allowing unauthorized yanking and republishing
Attacker-controlled gem with name before dash in targeted gem
Targeting gems created within past 30 days or not updated in over 100 days
Indicators of Compromise: Gemfile.lock showing platform changed with version numbers unchanged, e.g. gemname-3.1.2 renamed to gemname-3.1.2-java
